⚡ 助焊剂填充自动手动固定器工作流程 ⚡

WF特点：

✨ 真正的一键式操作（加载图像并运行）||通用图像支持||自动手部检测||多手修复|| 智能遮蔽引擎||助焊剂填充精度||零手工绘画👀

我们都经历过：你的镜头很完美，但手看起来像一堆意大利面条或一堆香肠。无论它是使用 SDXL、Pony、Flux、Z-Image、任何其他模型生成的，还是即使它是旧的遗留渲染 - 修复双手始终是一项手动斗争。

这个工作流程改变了游戏规则。无论您的图像来自哪里，这都是每个创作者在其工具包中需要的最终润色。

✨ 它有何特别之处？

这不仅仅是另一个修复设置。这是对不良解剖结构的全自动外科手术式打击。

  • 通用兼容性：适用于任何输入图像，无论原始模型或来源如何。

  • 自动检测魔法：专门的节点识别手并自动生成精确的掩模。不再需要笨拙的手工绘画！

  • 助焊剂填充力：它利用最先进的助焊剂填充逻辑以令人难以置信的真实感、正确的手指计数和匹配的纹理重新绘制手。

  • 我无数次的测试表明我们有第一次尝试的成功率高达 80-90%.

工作流程很简单：拖放。点击运行。观看魔法发生。非常适合那些重视质量但讨厌在繁琐的遮蔽上浪费时间的人。

🚀 您需要什么才能立即开始？

  • 这个工作流程 - 只是下载解压文件并将 *.json 加载到 ComfyUI 中

  • 助焊剂填充型号：Flux1-fill-dev-fp8.safetensors（放置在\模型\扩散_模型\)

  • 剪辑文本编码器文件 1：Clip_l.safetensors（放置在\模型\剪辑\)

  • 剪辑文本编码器文件 2：t5xxl_fp16.safetensors（放置在\模型\剪辑\)

  • VAE 文件：安全张量（放置在\模型\vae\)

如果您之前使用过 FLUX，那么您已经拥有 VAE 和两个文本编码器文件，无需再次下载它们。但如果您更喜欢更多细节，您可以尝试UltraFlux-v1 VAE 文件.

如果您运行 VRAM 较低的 GPU，您还可以使用FP4 助焊剂填充型号和FP8版本的t5xxl 文本编码器.

🚨 确保您使用最新的稳定 ComfyUI Core 版本。另外不要忘记更新 ComfyUI Frontend 包手动以及通过 ComfyUI Manager 的自定义节点。否则可能会出现兼容性问题并且工作流程无法正常工作。

此版本的工作流程是使用以下软件包制作的：

  • ComfyUI 核心 v0.3.77

  • ComfyUI 前端 v1.36.9

  • ComfyUI管理器 v3.39

  • Python 版本 3.12.10

  • PyTorch 版本 2.8.0+cu128

  • 下面列出了自定义节点的所有最新版本

请确保您至少使用这些版本。否则，如果某些内容不适合您，我将无法提供支持。

❓ 我是否需要一些特殊的节点来运行此工作流程？

该工作流程内的节点是公共节点。如果 ComfyUI 仍然指示缺少节点，只需通过 ComfyUI Manager 安装它并短暂重新启动。

此工作流程中使用的自定义节点：

  • rg三舒适

  • ComfyUI-Flux-连续体

  • 手动固定器

💡 使用提示：

  • 即插即用：您实际上不需要配置太多。只是拖放图像并点击“运行".

  • 提示：不要告诉人工智能该做什么（例如“修复坏手”）。告诉它你想要什么看到！使用“完美的女性手”或“完美的红指甲手”等提示。保持简单和描述性。

  • 你可以玩耍和测试与指导、步骤和噪声值:

  • >>> 指导范围：30-50（35-40 效果最佳）

  • >>> 步骤范围：20-35（25-30 是最佳点）

  • >>> 降噪范围：0.9-1.0（0.95 对我来说是最佳值）

  • 表现：更高分辨率的输入图像将需要更多时间来处理。

  • 多手支持：是的，它会自动检测并修复多只手！

如果您有优化/新功能请求的想法或只是想说“谢谢”，请随时在评论部分留言。如果您对此工作流程有疑问，请随时通过以下方式与我联系不和谐随时！

💕别忘了传播一些爱-点击“喜欢”按钮和跟着我（也于科菲）不要错过任何新的更新和更多像这样的工作流程！ 👍

如果您喜欢这些工作流程，您还可以给我买杯咖啡! ☕

祝您玩得开心，并随时将您的固定图像发布到下面的图库中！我想看看你用这个工作流程做了什么！😊

⚡ Flux Fill Automatic Hand Fixer Workflow ⚡

WF Features:

✨ True One-Click Operation (Load Image & Run)||Universal Image Support||Auto-Hand Detection||Multi Hand Fix|| Smart Masking Engine||Flux Fill Precision||Zero Manual Painting👀

We’ve all been there:You have the perfect shot, but the hands look like a pile of spaghetti or a bunch of sausages. Whether it was generated with SDXL, Pony, Flux, Z-Image, any other model or even if it's an old legacy render – fixing hands has always been a manual struggle.

This workflow changes the game.It doesn't matter where your image came from, this is the final polish every creator needs in their toolkit.

✨ What makes it special?

This isn't just another inpainting setup. It’s a fully automated surgical strike on bad anatomy.

  • Universal Compatibility:Works with any input image, regardless of the original model or source.

  • Auto-Detection Magic:A specialized node identifies hands and generates a precise mask automatically. No more clumsy manual painting!

  • Flux Fill Power:It utilizes the state-of-the-art Flux Fill logic to redraw hands with incredible realism, correct finger counts and matching textures.

  • My countless tests have shown that we have asuccess rate of 80-90% on the first attempt.

The Workflow is simple:Drag & Drop. Hit Run.Watch the magic happen. Perfect for those who value quality but hate wasting time on tedious masking.

🚀 What do you need to get started right away?

  • This Workflow - justdownloadit, unzip the file and load the *.json into ComfyUI

  • Flux Fill Model:flux1-fill-dev-fp8.safetensors(place in\models\diffusion_models\)

  • Clip Text Encoder File 1:clip_l.safetensors(place in\models\clip\)

  • Clip Text Encoder File 2:t5xxl_fp16.safetensors(place in\models\clip\)

  • The VAE file:ae.safetensors(place in\models\vae\)

If you used FLUX before then you already have the VAE and both text encoder files and don't need to download them again. But if you prefer more details you can try out theUltraFlux-v1 VAE file.

If you run a GPU with low VRAM you can also use theFP4 Flux Fill Modeland theFP8 Versionof thet5xxl Text Encoder.

🚨 Make sure you use the latest stable ComfyUI Core version. Also don't forget to update the ComfyUI Frontend packagemanuallyand your Custom Nodes via ComfyUI Manager. Otherwise compatibility problems may occur and the workflow is not working properly.

This version of the workflow was made with the following packages:

  • ComfyUI Core v0.3.77

  • ComfyUI Frontend v1.36.9

  • ComfyUI Manager v3.39

  • Python Version 3.12.10

  • PyTorch Version 2.8.0+cu128

  • All latest versions of the custom nodes listed below

Please ensure that you use at least these versions. Otherwise, I cannot provide support if something is not working for you.

❓ Do I need some special nodes to run this workflow?

The nodes inside this workflow are common nodes. If ComfyUI still indicates a missing node just install it via ComfyUI Manager and restart briefly.

Custom nodes used in this workflow:

  • rgthree-comfy

  • ComfyUI-Flux-Continuum

  • HandFixer

💡 Usage Tips:

  • Plug & Play:You really don't need to configure much. Justdrag and dropthe image and hit "Run".

  • Prompting:Don't tell the AI what to do (e.g. "fix bad hands"). Tell it what you want tosee! Use prompts like "perfect female hand" or "perfect hands with red nails". Keep it simple and descriptive.

  • You canplay around and testwith theguidance, steps and denoise values:

  • >>> Guidancerange: 30-50 (35-40 works best)

  • >>> Stepsrange: 20-35 (25-30 is the sweet spot)

  • >>> Denoiserange: 0.9-1.0 (0.95 is the best value for me)

  • Performance:Higher resolution input images will take more time to process.

  • Multi-Hand Support:Yes, it detects and fixes multiple hands automatically!

If you have ideas for optimization / new feature requests or just wanna say "thanks" feel free to leave a post in the comment section. If you have questions about this workflow, feel free to reach out to me onDiscordanytime!

💕 Don't forget to spread some love -hit the like buttonandfollow me(also onKo-Fi) to not miss any new updates and more workflows like this one! 👍

If you like these workflows you can alsobuy me a coffee! ☕

Have fun and feel free to post your fixed images in the gallery below! I would like to see what you do with this workflow!😊
